description: This file contains utility functions for reading a file into memory and printing input/output data, primarily used for unit testing in the 'ut_test_common' module. It includes functions to open, read, and handle file data, as well as print content for debugging purposes.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads the contents of a specified file into a memory buffer within a test utility structure, handling errors such as file open failure, seek errors, memory allocation issues, and read errors.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the content of a file (if successfully read) and output data for unit testing debugging, managing memory cleanup after reading.
